visual_summary: In a bright, arena-like chamber, four restrained or captive figures wearing transparent head domes are lined up before armed soldiers. An order to fire is given, and the next panel shows one captive being violently blasted apart while onlookers recoil. Below, a group of pale, large-headed cybernetic beings huddle together under guard as one terrified speaker explains their strategic situation: their galaxy and the Pthagurean galaxy are evenly matched, but the Metabaron is the deciding factor, and if the Pthagureans have chosen extermination, escape to another galaxy may be the only option.
